raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.11.7"

package:
  name: pyhdf
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pyhdf/pyhdf-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5c015589e0d01c191f70855a016ccd8c19106aba7390c9204f3e2a1b7080d335

build:
  number: 1
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-scm
    - pip
    - numpy
    - hdf4
    - zlib
  run:
    - python
    - numpy
    - hdf4
    - zlib

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyhdf
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Python interface to the NCSA HDF4 library
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/fhs/pyhdf

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - djhoese
    - ocefpaf

about.summary: Python interface to the NCSA HDF4 library
